test_evaluation_vs_failure_labels.interpretation_note: Ground-truth failure labels serve as an imperfect reference for unsupervised anomaly detection. An unusual operating point (statistical outlier) is not necessarily a mechanical breakdown, and certain failures (such as gradual tool wear) can occur within standard operating envelopes.

score_interpretation.rule: Score < 0 indicates atypical / anomalous operating condition; Score >= 0 indicates normal envelope.
